attributes.title: NASP inSPire 2027
attributes.summary:
NASP's 2027 annual conference, now branded inSPire, is scheduled for September 27 to 30, 2027, at the Gaylord Palms Resort & Convention Center in Orlando, Florida. The National Association of Specialty Pharmacy brings together specialty pharmacies, payers, manufacturers, health systems and patient groups, and its 2025 meeting drew more than 2,100 attendees.

CE details for 2027 have not been published yet. In 2026, pharmacists could earn 10.5 live ACPE contact hours in the main conference, up to 8 more in workshops and 1 in an accredited symposium, and NASP also offered CE for pharmacy technicians (ACPE), nurses and attorneys. Fees and the 2027 program will follow.
